Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and cost controls. We want to move forward with a short eval focused on our clinical summarization workflow. Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. I've sketched a targeted connectivity and onboarding checklist below that we can fold into a MAP PDF (attached). High level summary and proposed timeline follow.

Quick answers up front:
- Org: We can provision a NeuroHealth test org in our Private tenancy (recommended for data isolation) by Aug 9. If you prefer to use your sandbox, we can still proceed but there are trade-offs on audit/log access.
- API keys: We'll issue two scoped API keys for the POC (read-only for ingestion + full-access for evaluation). Keys are issued via Console and rotated on a 30-day cadence; for the POC we can schedule one manual rotation on week 3.
- IP allowlist & peering: We support both IP allowlist and VPC peering. Typical flow is: you supply egress CIDR ranges -> our infra team confirms NAT/peering config -> schedule peering handoff.
- Timeline: Proposed POC window: Aug 16 — Sep 10 (4 weeks). Kickoff + infra prep Aug 9–15.

Connectivity & MAP checklist (for your infra/security team):
1) Org provisioning
   - Confirm: dedicated NeuroHealth test org (Private) or reuse existing sandbox
   - Action owner: Redwood (soojin_lee) to provision; NeuroHealth to confirm admin contacts

2) API keys & roles
   - Deliverable: 2 API keys (ingest, eval) + service account details
   - Roles: ingestion role limited to POST/generate; eval role includes embeddings/management endpoints
   - Notes: keys issued via Console, rotate once during POC (week 3)

3) IP allowlist (minimum requirement to start)
   - NeuroHealth to provide outbound egress CIDR ranges (example: 34.120.0.0/16; 34.121.0.0/16)
   - Redwood to provide endpoint IPs and FQDNs for allowlisting

4) VPC peering (optional, recommended for low-latency)
   - Exchange VPC IDs and peering contact; coordinate peering window (2–4 hours)
   - Validation: ping tests, traceroutes, application-level smoke tests

5) Security/compliance artifacts
   - Required: SOC2 report excerpt, data retention policy, KMS integration notes

6) Acceptance criteria & close metrics
   - Throughput: sustain 20 qps of short summaries at avg latency < 350ms
   - Cost: target token cost metric shared after first week
   - Quality: baseline eval set F1/ROUGE scores in MAP doc

Attachments included: NH_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (draft MAP with milestones). I copied Marissa and Karthik to align on sales/peering logistics. Next steps: if this checklist looks good, can NeuroHealth give a greenlight on org choice and share egress CIDRs by Thu, Aug 5? We can lock kickoff for Aug 9.

Thanks — I'll add these to a shared Drive doc and update the MAP.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee

Looping in a few technical specifics from infra that we should lock before the peering window. Quoting Soojin's note: 

> 3) IP allowlist (minimum requirement to start)
>    - NeuroHealth to provide outbound egress CIDR ranges (example: 34.120.0.0/16; 34.121.0.0/16)
>    - Redwood to provide endpoint IPs and FQDNs for allowlisting

A few clarifications / asks for NeuroHealth infra:
- Please provide CIDRs for all environments (dev/qa/prod) you intend to hit during the POC. If you only want dev/qa, specify that — we will only enable endpoints for those ranges.
- For VPC peering: we need the VPC ID, region, and the peering contact (email and phone). Peering requires a scheduled maintenance window on your side and ours; typically we ask for a 2-hour window during low traffic.
- TLS and certs: Redwood terminates TLS at the edge; for private peering we recommend mutual TLS for the service account if you need zero-trust verification. Let us know if NeuroHealth can accept mTLS or prefers IP-based control only.
- Service accounts & IAM: we'll create a service account; NeuroHealth must create a role mapping for it with the minimum necessary permissions.

Attached is a sample network_requirements.xlsx with the fields we need populated. If Alice/Ben can fill and return by Mon, Aug 2, we can target Aug 9 org provisioning.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
